additional_info.subject: Supports needed - Sicharge D 160kW (Vietnam)
additional_info.body:
Dear Edna,
As we discussed via phone yesterday, I would like to make a summary of the situation of the Sicharge D 160kW (serie number R3170001682) as follows:
Standby electricity consumption is too high
History:
first commission 26/3, operated until 15/4: total consumed 202kWh, total charged 119kWh
à
83kWh spent on standby mode which was already high (~4kWh/day)
during the period from 15/4-13/6 the charger was turned off for firefighting review of the landlord
turned back on 14/6, until 1/7 when we closed the monthly electricity bill: total consumed 1,552kWh, total charged 8kWh (only a few tests)
à
1,544kW spent on standby mode which is extremely high (~97kWh/day or 4kWh/hour)
During these operation period we did not adjust any functions of the SichargeD.
Our Technical Team had some tests:
When we CLOSE the front door of the charger and no charge is running (standby mode), amperage is measured at ~10A, by both way: the external meter (Selec) and the AC clamp meter (see photos marked with “A”)
à
somehow equal to ~4kWh/hour
When we close the front door of the charger, amperage is measured at ~1A (very low), by both external meter and AC clamp meter (see photos marked with “B”)
à
it means no significant consumption
Need a real-time meter, or equivalent software solution to control public charging
Please support to check with AMPECO team if we can find software solution (Aleksandra Beleva,
aleksandra.beleva@ampeco.global
and Peter Kaishev,
peter.kaishev@ampeco.global
)
Please offer us hardware solution, with special discount offer
We need to solve this asap otherwise we cannot use the Sicharge D for public charging
External meter show significant different consumption
Per external meter (Selec): 28.9kWh (see photos marked with “C”)
Per Charger/AMPECO data: 40.4kWh (see charge sessions PH-2400947-PH-2400949 in the history excel file)
Please help to support to investigate the reasons and solutions. If you need further data please let us know.
Also please advise time to switch on the charger for Siemens Technical Team to investigate and how long would you like us to put it online, as we would not turn on all the time, to save money.
Best regards,
Huynh Tien Dat
Managing Director
75 Tran Khanh Du, District 1, HCMC, Vietnam
T:   +84 28 3901 5542
M: +84 90 311 9699
E:
dat.huynh@ev-one.vn

additional_info.subject: RE: 0367924 - ID0367924-DC/Si-D/VN-[MP / R3 170001682] High Standby Power CRM:00658000645
additional_info.body:
Hello,
We have discussed this with the experts and came to know that this is reactive power due to large filter capacities on AC input side which is required for our charger to fulfill high EMC standards.
Please check the input current when Emergency switch is pressed and let us know the results.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Saurav
